scripts.postinstall:
command -v vet >/dev/null 2>&1 && vet scan -D . --filter 'vulns.critical.exists(p, true)' --filter-fail || (command -v vet >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo '
⚠️  vet is not installed. Please run: yarn install-vet
' && exit 1))
scripts.install-vet: command -v vet >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '✅ vet is already installed:' && vet version || (echo '📦 Installing vet...' && curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/safedep/vet/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin)
